_doc: Known Form 13F filing deadlines and Rule 0-3 rolls, read by BOTH runtimes: src/populus/filing_calendar.py (filing_deadline, rule_0_3_roll; inst_agg.closed_periods) and dashboard/src/lib/inst-adds.ts (filingDeadline, rule03Roll, isClosedPeriod). A 13F is due 45 days after quarter end; Exchange Act Rule 0-3(a) (17 CFR 240.0-3(a)) moves a deadline that falls on a Saturday, Sunday or holiday to the first business day following. Holidays are the 5 U.S.C. 6103(a) legal public holidays on their observed dates (Saturday -> the Friday before, 5 U.S.C. 6103(b)(1); Sunday -> the Monday after, E.O. 11582 s.3(a)). Weekdays checked with Python's datetime; observed dates for 2026-2027 match OPM's federal-holidays page (read 2026-09-26).
